content: Figure FIGREF10 shows that agents utilizing knowledge-graphs in addition to either enhanced exploration method far outperform the baseline A2C and KG-A2C. KG-A2C-chained and KG-A2C-Explore both pass the bottleneck of a score of 40, whereas A2C-Explore gets to the bottleneck but cannot surpass it.
